title: Bounded Complete Preparation Run
statement: For any Boolean words $w,s$, there is a natural number $t\le 5(|s|+|w|+3)$ such that the preparation machine started from its initial frame reaches phase $8$ at time $t$, with candidate $s$ on its first tape, an empty second tape, the suffix of $w$ after its first $|s|$ symbols on its third tape, all heads at the positions specified by the resulting frame, and the overflow flag recording whether $|w|<|s|$.
hypotheses_covered: At time $t$, the machine reaches the specified phase-$8$ frame with candidate $s$, empty second tape, suffix on third tape, specified head positions, and overflow flag equal to the truth value of $|w|<|s|$
replaced:
For any input $w$ and candidate $s$, there is a time
$t \le 5(\abs{s} + \abs{w} + 3)$ after which the candidate-and-suffix
preparation machine, started from its initial frame, presents the candidate
$s$ and the native suffix of $w$ after position $\abs{s}$ on clean argument
tapes, with every head and the native input position restored and the
overflow flag recording whether $\abs{w} < \abs{s}$.
